Name: (CP) Friendly Magical Vegan Truffle Bears
Author: Purr0wpet
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]WHAT IS IT??[/size]
MS Paintra transformed the pigs into Friendly Magical Vegan Truffle Bears, which take over the baby pigs when they grow up. However, they only uploaded the .xnb file. I've taken that and updated it to a content pack for those who prefer to use Content Patcher :)

[size=4]HOW DO I USE IT????[/size]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install SMAPI if you don't already have it[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install Content Patcher if you don't already have it[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Unzip the folder, and place the unzipped folder into the Mods folder (this can be found in the Stardew Valley folder)[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4]CREDIT[/size]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]MS Paintdra for creating the .xnb file[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
